battleFormations.name: Realspace Raiders
battleFormations.effect: Alliance of Agony: At the start of the battle, gain 2 Pain tokens for each qualifying combination in your army: Archon+Kabalite Warriors, Succubus+Wyches, Haemonculus+Wracks (cumulative, up to 6 Pain tokens).

battleFormations.name: Spectacle of Spite
battleFormations.effect: Combat Drugs: At the start of your Command phase, select or randomly roll two Combat Drugs (Adrenalight +1A, Hypex +2"M, Serpentin +1WS, Painbringer +1T, Grave Lotus +1S, Splintermind +1LD/+1BS) active for WYCH CULT models until your next Command phase.

battleFormations.name: Skysplinter Assault
battleFormations.effect: Rain Of Cruelty: Each time a DRUKHARI unit disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn its ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER] and melee weapons gain [LANCE].

battleFormations.name: Covenite Coterie
battleFormations.effect: Stitchflesh Abominations: Each time an attack targets a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit with Strength greater than its Toughness, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

artefacts.name: Dark Vitality
artefacts.effect: [DRUKHARI model only] The bearer's unit is always Empowered without spending Pain tokens.

artefacts.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
artefacts.effect: [ARCHON model only] At the start of your Command phase, spend 1 Pain token to gain 1CP, or roll a D6 (4+ = gain 1CP).

artefacts.name: Eye of Spite
artefacts.effect: [SUCCUBUS model only] +1 Attacks/AP in melee (spend 1 Pain token for +2/+2 instead).

artefacts.name: Crucible of Malediction
artefacts.effect: [HAEMONCULUS model only] Once per battle, force nearby enemy units to Battle-shock test (spend 1 Pain token for -1 to the test); failed PSYKER units suffer 3 mortal wounds.

artefacts.name: Phantasmal Smoke
artefacts.effect: [DRUKHARI model only] While within 6" of a friendly Transport, the bearer's unit gains Stealth and Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

artefacts.name: Sadistic Fulcrum
artefacts.effect: [DRUKHARI model only] When spending a Pain token to Empower the bearer's unit in the Shooting phase, a nearby Transport can re-roll Hit rolls.

artefacts.name: Spiteful Raider
artefacts.effect: [DRUKHARI model only] Destroying an enemy unit near an objective in the Fight phase grants an additional Pain token.

artefacts.name: Nightmare Shroud
artefacts.effect: [DRUKHARI model only] After disembarking, enemies cannot use Fire Overwatch against the bearer's unit that turn.

artefacts.name: Pharmacophex
artefacts.effect: [SUCCUBUS model only] Roll an extra random Combat Drug that applies only to the bearer's unit.

artefacts.name: Chronoshard
artefacts.effect: [SUCCUBUS model only] Once per battle, the bearer's unit gains Fights First.

artefacts.name: Periapt of Torments

artefacts.name: Morghenna's Curse

artefacts.name: Master Regenesist
artefacts.effect: [HAEMONCULUS model only] Fleshcraft returns up to D3+3 destroyed models instead of D3+1.

artefacts.name: Master Artisan
artefacts.effect: [HAEMONCULUS model only] +1 Wounds to bearer; +1 Toughness to unit.

artefacts.name: Master Repugnomancer
artefacts.effect: [HAEMONCULUS model only] Aura: +3" range to Fear Incarnate; chance to gain a Pain token each time a nearby unit fails Battle-shock or is destroyed.

armyRules.name: Power from Pain
armyRules.effect: All DRUKHARI units have Pain abilities that only apply while Empowered. Gain 1 Pain token at the start of your Command phase, each time an enemy unit is destroyed, and each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test. Spend Pain tokens to Empower a unit until the end of the phase, activating its Pain abilities (and those of its Leader/Bodyguard units).

armyRules.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
armyRules.effect: Your army can include HARLEQUINS and ANHRATHE units without the DRUKHARI Faction keyword, up to 250/500/750pts by battle size. These models cannot be Warlord and cannot receive Enhancements.
